rules.name: paper-inspired-29-ply-adaptation
rules.note: The pinned author's backend starts at turn=0 and adjudicates at MAX_TURNS-1 with default MAX_TURNS=30: 29 plies. This adaptation follows that cap but awards ties to black as described in the paper; the snapshot's cap expression instead favors white. See docs/paper-audit.md.

representation.name: hybrid-relative-v1
differences: Directions use native axial order, not Beekeeper numbering.
Reference is the lowest stable tile ID among stationary adjacent/underlying pieces.
Occupied bounding box is centered independently for each symmetry.
Rule state and repetition history stay in the native object, outside the observation.

evaluation_provenance.compiler:
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.6.4.2)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin

elo_method: regularized logistic fit, draws=half-point, centered at 1000; not BayesElo
baseline_provenance: Local minimax and rollout MCTS; not the paper's Beekeeper agents
